units.source_text: 大学考试之日，王侯贵族的车马云集大学寮门前，不可胜数。

en.t: On the day of the university examinations, the carriages and horses of princes, nobles, and high officials gathered before the gate of the Bureau of Education in numbers too great to count.

units.source_text: 几乎满朝公卿全部来到了。

en.t: Nearly all the courtiers of the whole court had come.

units.source_text: 冠者夕雾公子由无数人员簇拥而入，其仪容之俊美，实不堪与一般考生为伍。

en.t: The newly capped young lord Yugiri entered surrounded by countless attendants, and his handsome bearing was truly too splendid to be placed among ordinary examinees.

units.source_text: 以前参与起字仪式的那一群寒酸儒者也来了，教夕雾列席他们之末座，难怪他心中委屈呢。

en.t: The shabby Confucian scholars who had earlier taken part in his naming ceremony were there as well, and they made Yugiri sit at the lowest place among them, so it was no wonder that he felt wronged.

units.source_text: 这里也像起字仪式中一样，那些监考的儒学博士常对人大声斥骂，甚是可厌。

en.t: Here too, as at the naming ceremony, the Confucian doctors who supervised the examination often shouted harsh scoldings at people, which was extremely unpleasant.

units.source_text: 但夕雾不慌不忙，从容诵读。

en.t: But Yugiri remained unhurried and calm, and recited with composure.

units.source_text: 此时大学甚为繁荣，不亚于古昔全盛之时。

en.t: At this time the university was flourishing greatly, no less than in its ancient golden age.

units.source_text: 上中下人各级官员子弟，竞尚此道，集中于学术研究。

en.t: The sons of officials of every rank, high, middle, and low, all vied to honor this path and devoted themselves to scholarly study.

units.source_text: 因此世间多才多艺之人，日益增多。

en.t: As a result, people of many talents and accomplishments grew more numerous in the world day by day.

units.source_text: 夕雾此次应考，文章生、拟文章生等考试全都及第。

en.t: In this examination, Yugiri passed all the tests, including those for monjo no sho and provisional monjo no sho.

units.source_text: 今后师弟二人便更加用心教习，励志治学了。

en.t: From then on, teacher and pupil applied themselves even more earnestly to teaching, learning, and the pursuit of scholarship.

units.source_text: 源氏又在邸内举办诗会，博士、学者等均来参与，扬扬得意。

en.t: Genji also held a poetry gathering at his residence, where doctors and scholars all came to take part, full of proud satisfaction.

units.source_text: 这真是学术繁荣、文运昌隆的时代。

en.t: It was truly an age when learning flourished and literary culture prospered.
